title: Recursive construction of scalar one-loop integrals in dimensional regularisation
summary: We derive a novel recursive structure for dimensionally regularised scalar one-loop Feynman integrals based on Schläfli's differential formula for hyperbolic simplices. The recursion relates the Laurent coefficients in the dimensional regulator $\varepsilon$ of an $N$-point integral to lower-order coefficients of integrals with additional external legs. The construction is seeded by the $\varepsilon=0$ contributions, which admit a geometric interpretation as volumes of simplices in hyperbolic space and are known in terms of multiple polylogarithms (MPLs).
